_README: Connection manifest for the Orchestration Board, for any agent that speaks MCP.
Gemini CLI: merge into ~/.gemini/settings.json. Most other MCP clients take this shape too.
Codex CLI uses TOML instead — see board.codex.toml next to this file.
Fill in the three env values, then ask your agent to list its tools; board_* should appear.
If your agent does NOT speak MCP, ignore this file and use CONNECT.md, which documents the
plain HTTP protocol and needs nothing installed.
server.py is the file from the agent/ directory of this project. Give its ABSOLUTE path.
